generation.gooo_source:
package records
namespace fieldassembly
entity Text id "fieldassembly://text"
entity Boolean id "fieldassembly://boolean"
entity Candidate id "fieldassembly://candidate" fields {
    field title id "fieldassembly://candidate/title" type string required one
    field state id "fieldassembly://candidate/state" type string required one
    field reason id "fieldassembly://candidate/reason" type string required one
}
activity Select(Candidate, Boolean) -> Candidate computes "var copy = input0\nif input1 && copy.state != \"ready\" {\n    copy = Candidate{title: (input0.title), state: (\"ready\"), reason: \"deferred\"}\n} else {\n    copy = input0\n}\nreturn copy" assembling {
    baseline "let copy = input0\nif input1 && copy.state != \"ready\" {\n    copy = Candidate{title: \"draft\", state: \"wait\", reason: \"deferred\"}\n} else {\n    copy = input0\n}\nreturn copy"
    picked "title" -> "value_second"
    picked "state" -> "value_second"
    picked "reason" -> "value_first"
    choice "title" field_value at "0" alternative "input0.title" intent "원래 제목을 사용한다. Keep the original title."
    choice "state" field_value at "1" alternative "\"ready\"" intent "선택된 기록의 상태는 ready이다. Set state to ready."
    choice "reason" field_value at "2" alternative "input0.reason + \":accepted\"" intent "기존 사유에 accepted를 붙인다. Append accepted to the reason."
    value_case "[{\"reason\":\"검토\",\"state\":\"queued\",\"title\":\"한글\"},true]" -> "{\"reason\":\"검토:accepted\",\"state\":\"ready\",\"title\":\"한글\"}"
    value_case "[{\"reason\":\"review\",\"state\":\"queued\",\"title\":\"English\"},true]" -> "{\"reason\":\"review:accepted\",\"state\":\"ready\",\"title\":\"English\"}"
    value_case "[{\"reason\":\"\",\"state\":\"queued\",\"title\":\"\"},true]" -> "{\"reason\":\":accepted\",\"state\":\"ready\",\"title\":\"\"}"
    value_case "[{\"reason\":\"later\",\"state\":\"queued\",\"title\":\"kept\"},false]" -> "{\"reason\":\"later\",\"state\":\"queued\",\"title\":\"kept\"}"
    value_case "[{\"reason\":\"done\",\"state\":\"ready\",\"title\":\"already\"},true]" -> "{\"reason\":\"done\",\"state\":\"ready\",\"title\":\"already\"}"
    attempts "4"
}
activity Label(Candidate) -> Text computes `return input.title + ":" + input.state + ":" + input.reason`
bind Select.result -> Label.input
